response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates exceptional software engineering maturity and communication abilities, they are fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. The position mandates 5-10 years of professional C++ development on Windows; this candidate has only ~6 months of professional C++ experience (National Instruments, 2014-2015) and no documented Windows platform work. Additionally, the candidate entirely lacks the mandatory domain expertise in capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking. Their 20-year career is rooted in web/Node.js, mobile, and open-source projects—not enterprise financial systems. No amount of general engineering excellence compensates for these fundamental gaps.
strengths: 20+ years of professional software development experience with demonstrated seniority and technical leadership
Exceptional communication and teaching abilities, evidenced by multiple conference presentations, workshops, and course development
Strong software engineering practices including TDD, CI/CD pipeline expertise, infrastructure knowledge (GitLab, Docker), and demonstrated ability to work across diverse technical stacks
concerns: Only ~6 months of documented professional C++ experience (National Instruments, 2014-2015) versus mandatory requirement of 5-10 years
Zero experience in capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial services domains—mandatory to have at least one
Career trajectory focused on web development (Node.js, TypeScript), not Windows-based enterprise systems or financial platform development; no evidence of SQL Server/Oracle expertise
